Notice Of Motion And Motion In Support Of Plaintiffs Motion To Amend Complaint
Off Calendar Mar-09-2016 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
APPEARANCES: Atty. SEAN MCHENRY, ESQ. of Minnis & Smallets LLP, Tel No. 415-551-0885 appearing for the Plaintiff;
Atty. STEPHEN H. DYE of Schander Harrison Segal & Lewis LLP, Tel No. 415-364-6713 appearing for Defendants Chemoil Corporation and Glencore Ltd.

Matter argued and submitted by counsel. The Court adopts its tentative ruling with modifications, and orders as follows: As to PLAINTIFF MATTHEW BOWER'S Motion To Amend Complaint, Plaintiff's motion to file an amended complaint is granted on the condition stated in this order. The condition is that plaintiff must provide verified responses no later than March 23, 2016 to the following discovery: 1) state all facts in support of the two new claims, 2) state the names of all witnesses with knowledge of those facts and which facts they know, and 3) produce all non-privileged documents relating or referring to those facts. Plaintiff is precluded from submitting any evidence in opposition to a summary judgment/adjudication motion on the two new claims or introducing any evidence at trial on those claims that are not provided in his discovery responses [that was in his possession, custody or control at the time plaintiff made the responses. With this discovery, there is no prejudice to defendant by the granting of the motion. The court does not rule on whether either or both of the two new claims are valid claims. Such a ruling is better made on a motion challenging a pleading such as a demurrer than a motion seeking leave to file a pleading. Defendants' summary judgment motion may be heard up to August 8, 2016. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. Judge: Harold Kahn; Clerk: Sean Kane; Reporter: Sherry Sawyer, CSR #5976 (302/HK)

CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE
Off Calendar Jan-13-2016 Set For Trial On Aug-22-16 At 09:30 A.M. In Dept 206

DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT
Off Calendar Dec-16-2015 Overruled
MINI MINUTES:

Appearances: Sean McHenry of Minnis & Smallets telephone number 415-551-0885 for Plaintiff.
Stephen Dye of Schnader Attorneys At Law telephone number 415-364-6713 for Defendant.

The matter was argued. Upon conclusion of argument, the Court confirmed its tentative ruling. DEFENDANTS CHEMOIL CORPORATION AND GLENCORE LTD.'S DEMURRER TO PLAINTIFF'S COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES is overruled in its entirety. All of plaintiff's claims are adequately alleged. In reviewing a demurrer the court only examines the legal sufficiency of a cause of action, not the truth of the evidence. (Quelimane Co. v. Stewart Title Guaranty Co. (1998) 19 Cal.4th 26.) The allegations that defendants terminated plaintiff's employment after he reported the labor and employment violations and after those claims were investigated, when combined with the allegation that the other employees had been laid off in June 2014, sufficiently support plaintiff's claims. Nor are any of plaintiff's claims uncertain. Order signed in open Court.

Judge: Harold Kahn. Clerk: Rosie Noguera. Reporter: Irene L. Tofft, CSR #12913. (302/HK)
